scope: Hero identity anchors, summon art, and evolution art
decision: Use cinematic semi-realistic painted character art at this realism ceiling. Do not push future hero production into literal live-action photography or ultra-photorealism.
adopt: believable adult anatomy, weight, skin, hair, cloth, leather, and metal
polished painterly game-key-art finish with controlled texture
recognizable faces and stable body identity across evolution
clear garment construction and dramatic but readable high-rank effects
calm identity-consistent facial affect unless a scene explicitly calls for another expression
avoid: photo-specific pore, lens, and skin-detail prompting
anime simplification, cel shading, or exaggerated facial acting
treating this style reference as an approved hero or runtime asset
assetRole: visual-direction reference; not a hero candidate, approved hero identity, or runtime asset
